components.label: Description／成分
components.quote: HAVRIX (Hepatitis A Vaccine) is a sterile, injectable suspension of inactivated virus for intramuscular use.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
Each 1 mL adult dose of vaccine contains 1440 EL.U. of viral antigen, adsorbed on 0.5 mg of aluminum as
aluminum hydroxide.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
HAVRIX contains the following excipients: Amino acid supplement (0.3% w/v) in a phosphate-buffered saline
solution and polysorbate 20 (0.05 mg/mL). From the manufacturing process, HAVRIX also contains residual
MRC-5 cellular proteins (not more than 5 mcg/mL), formalin (not more than 0.1 mg/mL), and neomycin sulfate
(not more than 40 ng/mL), an aminoglycoside antibiotic included in the cell growth media.

allergens.quote:
The tip cap and rubber plunger stopper of the prefilled syringe are
not made with natural rubber latex.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote:
Severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) after a previous dose of any hepatitis A-containing vaccine, or to any
component of HAVRIX, including neomycin, is a contraindication to administration of HAVRIX

warnings.label: Latex
warnings.quote:
The tip cap and rubber plunger stopper of the prefilled syringe are
not made with natural rubber latex.

dismissed.egg: 命中詞'hen'皆為'when'字尾，與雞蛋/雞胚無關，仿單全文未提蛋／卵白蛋白（病毒株於 MRC-5 人類二倍體細胞繁殖）
dismissed.other_antibiotics: 命中詞'antibiotic'出自描述 neomycin sulfate 本身（'an aminoglycoside antibiotic'），已列於 neomycin key，非額外的其他抗生素
